description: This file defines the PlaywrightConnection class which manages a remote connection in the Playwright testing framework, handling message dispatching, connection lifecycle, and cleanup procedures.

classes.name: PlaywrightConnection
classes.description: Manages a remote Playwright connection, handling message passing, disconnection, and cleanup.

methods.name: _onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup and resource release when the connection is disconnected.

methods.name: logServerMetadata
methods.description: Logs metadata about messages sent or received for debugging purposes.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection, optionally with a reason.
